title: Calculate explainable threshold profiles
evidence_required: FT-011-AC-001 RED: complete runs expose no deterministic Best face match, Balance or Minimum missed faces winners with required counts/metrics and contributing-Attempt drill-down; GREEN: each named pipeline result calculates all three profiles with the accepted ranking and complete output, including exact aggregate F1 and full tie-break order; decisive comparison: a fixed snapshot and independent oracle compare every winner/output and reconcile aggregates to Attempt locators; artifact: focused oracle output under .tasks/TASK-102-T2-FT-011-W2/.

FT-011-AC-006 RED: all-candidates-undefined input can yield NaN/infinity or an unsupported proposal without an explicit sample warning; GREEN: it reports unavailable metrics plus selected/applicable counts, emits no proposal and leaves serving state unchanged; decisive comparison: a zero-denominator fixed fixture inspects serialized output, absent proposal and before/after settings; artifact: focused unavailable-result output under .tasks/TASK-102-T2-FT-011-W2/.
purpose: Implement only the three accepted threshold profiles and their honest undefined-metric behavior over one completed immutable run.
success_outcome: Each named pipeline result yields deterministic explainable threshold recommendations and drill-down, while an all-candidates-undefined sample yields no proposal.
anti_goals: Do not implement quality-gate optimization, joint objectives, learned weighting or a configurable search framework.
Do not invent a minimum sample threshold or hide missing ground truth as an outcome.
Do not implement staff routes, apply, worker, promotion or retention behavior.

forbidden_scope: Serving-control state mutation and automatic apply
Quality-gate analysis, worker runtime, staff HTTP and retention
Production/operator datasets and unredacted participant information in evidence
stop_conditions: A deterministic profile requires an objective or tie-break not accepted in FT-011 and Calibration Verification.
The calculation requires combining SFace and Buffalo M outcomes or inventing absent annotations.
A truthful unavailable result requires defining a new minimum sample threshold.

constraints: Calculate counts, precision, recall and aggregate F1 only from the completed run's immutable applicable annotation snapshot and retained finite candidates.
Apply the exact accepted ranking/tie-break order independently for each named pipeline revision and retain stable Attempt locators for every aggregate.
Represent undefined denominators as unavailable; only the all-candidates-undefined case produces no threshold proposal, with no invented adequacy cutoff.
invariants: SFace and Buffalo M profile results remain separate and no embeddings or participant-facing results cross revisions.
Missing ground truth contributes nothing; explicit correct, false and missed rows alone affect counts.
Calculation and viewing never mutate serving settings or revision.
verification_targets: A fixed independent oracle proves each ranking, complete tie-break order, counts, precision/recall/F1, sample size and Attempt reconciliation for both native pipeline results.
Zero-denominator fixtures prove unavailable serialization without NaN/infinity, absent proposal, explicit selected/applicable counts and unchanged serving state.
